verses.text_urhobo: Ọrovwohwo de bru Sera rhe kirobo rọ ta kẹ jovwo, Ọrovwohwo de ru kẹ Sera kirobo ro vẹ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: orovwohwo de bru sera rhe kirobo ro ta ke jovwo orovwohwo de ru ke sera kirobo ro ve ke

verses.text_urhobo: Sera da mrevun, o de vwiẹ ọmọshare kẹ Ebraham vwẹ uyovwi esha na vwẹ ọke rẹ Ọghẹnẹ vẹ phihọ kẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: sera da mrevun o de vwie omoshare ke ebraham vwe uyovwi esha na vwe oke re oghene ve phiho ke na

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham de se odẹ rẹ ọmọ na re vwiẹ kẹ na, ri Sera vwiẹ kẹ na Aizik.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham de se ode re omo na re vwie ke na ri sera vwie ke na aizik

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da yanvwọ ọmọ rọye Aizik rọ vwọ gba ẹdẹ ẹrenren, kiri urhi rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ji kẹ
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da yanvwo omo roye aizik ro vwo gba ede erenren kiri urhi re oghene ji ke

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da dia ikpe ujori vwẹ ọke re vwo vwiẹ ọmọ rọye Aizik kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da dia ikpe ujori vwe oke re vwo vwie omo roye aizik ke

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Sera da ta, Ọghẹnẹ ma ehwẹ kẹ vwẹ; kohwo kohwo ro nyori ejobi kọ cha hwẹ vwẹ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin sera da ta oghene ma ehwe ke vwe kohwo kohwo ro nyori ejobi ko cha hwe vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta, Kono re ata kẹ Ebraham nẹ Sera cha vwẹ evie kẹ ọmọ? Dede na yi mi vwiẹ ọmọ kẹ vwẹ uyovwi esha na.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta kono re ata ke ebraham ne sera cha vwe evie ke omo dede na yi mi vwie omo ke vwe uyovwi esha na

verses.text_urhobo: Ọmọ na da rhe rho, o de rhi bro evie; Ebraham de rhi chere emu buebu vwẹ ẹdẹ rẹ Aizik vwo bru evie nu.
verses.text_romanized: omo na da rhe rho o de rhi bro evie ebraham de rhi chere emu buebu vwe ede re aizik vwo bru evie nu

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Sera da mrẹ ọmọ ri Hagar rẹ ohwo rẹ Ijipt na, ro vwiẹ vwọ kẹ Ebraham na, rọ vẹ Aizik rẹ ọmọ rọye gba ha eha.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo sera da mre omo ri hagar re ohwo re ijipt na ro vwie vwo ke ebraham na ro ve aizik re omo roye gba ha eha

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ Ebraham, Djẹ aye na ọviẹn na vẹ ọmọ rọye kufia, kidie ọmọ rẹ aye nana rẹ ọviẹn na vẹ ọmọ mẹ Aizik se koko re uku-u.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke ebraham dje aye na ovien na ve omo roye kufia kidie omo re aye nana re ovien na ve omo me aizik se koko re uku u

verses.text_urhobo: Emu nana de tun Ebraham oma vwi fiki rẹ ọmọ rọye.
verses.text_romanized: emu nana de tun ebraham oma vwi fiki re omo roye

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ Ebraham, Wo jẹ Ọnana tun we oma vwi fiki rẹ ọmọ na vẹ aye na rẹ ọviẹn na-a; obo ri Sera ta kẹ wẹ ejobi, ru kirobo rọ tare kidie oma rẹ Aizik ọye uvwiẹ wẹn de che vwo odẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oghene da ta ke ebraham wo je onana tun we oma vwi fiki re omo na ve aye na re ovien na a obo ri sera ta ke we ejobi ru kirobo ro tare kidie oma re aizik oye uvwie wen de che vwo ode

verses.text_urhobo: Ki mi ji ru rere ẹgborho vwo nẹ oma rẹ ọmọ rẹ aye rẹ ọviẹn na rhe, fikiridie ọmọ obọ wẹn oruẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ki mi ji ru rere egborho vwo ne oma re omo re aye re ovien na rhe fikiridie omo obo wen orue

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Ebraham de vrẹn vwẹ irhiọke ride, ọ da reyọ ikara vẹ ophiẹn rẹ ame, ọ da vwọ kẹ Hagar, ọ da vwọ ya igabọ, kugbe ọmọ na, o de ji ayen yanran. O de vrẹn yanran ko di muẹ yan vwẹ aghwa ri Bẹẹrsheba.
verses.text_romanized: koye ebraham de vren vwe irhioke ride o da reyo ikara ve ophien re ame o da vwo ke hagar o da vwo ya igabo kugbe omo na o de ji ayen yanran o de vren yanran ko di mue yan vwe aghwa ri beersheba

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ ame rọ evun rẹ ophiẹn na vwo re nu, o de mu ọmọ na phihọ otọ rẹ etu.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ame ro evun re ophien na vwo re nu o de mu omo na phiho oto re etu

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da yanran re tidia tephe vwẹ ogboko kẹ ọmọ na vwẹ uvwre rẹ asan rẹ umurhabọ sa yan te, kidie ọ tare ne, E ju vwe mrẹ orivwi rẹ ọmọ na-a. Ọke ro vwo tidia oboyi ro vwo no re, ọmọ na da teye ugoroviẹ.
verses.text_romanized: o da yanran re tidia tephe vwe ogboko ke omo na vwe uvwre re asan re umurhabo sa yan te kidie o tare ne e ju vwe mre orivwi re omo na a oke ro vwo tidia oboyi ro vwo no re omo na da teye ugorovie

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ de nyo oviẹ rẹ ọmọ na, Etiyin amakashe rẹ Ọghẹnẹ de se Hagar nẹ obo odjuvwu rhe, ọ da ta kẹ, Die ri kpokpo uwe, Hagar? Wọ djẹ oshọ-ọ, kidie Ọghẹnẹ nyo urhuru rẹ ọmọ na vwẹ asan rọ epha.
verses.text_romanized: oghene de nyo ovie re omo na etiyin amakashe re oghene de se hagar ne obo odjuvwu rhe o da ta ke die ri kpokpo uwe hagar wo dje osho o kidie oghene nyo urhuru re omo na vwe asan ro epha

verses.text_urhobo: Vrẹn wọ kpare ọmọ na, ru wọ yọnrọn kokoroko vwẹ obọ wẹn, kidie mi che ruo phihọ ẹgborho rode
verses.text_romanized: vren wo kpare omo na ru wo yonron kokoroko vwe obo wen kidie mi che ruo phiho egborho rode

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ de rhie ẹro rọye, ọ da mrẹ orhare rẹ ame, ọ da yanran, re vo ame vọn ophiẹn rọye, ọ da vwọ kẹ ọmọ na da.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene de rhie ero roye o da mre orhare re ame o da yanran re vo ame von ophien roye o da vwo ke omo na da

verses.text_urhobo: Ọghẹnẹ vẹ ọmọ na da herọ, ọ da rhe rho, ọ dia evun rẹ aghwa, o de rhi hirhe ọsedada.
verses.text_romanized: oghene ve omo na da hero o da rhe rho o dia evun re aghwa o de rhi hirhe osedada

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da dia aghwa ri Paran, oni rọye da reyọ ọmọtẹ rẹ Ijipt vwọ kẹ vwọ rọvwọ
verses.text_romanized: o da dia aghwa ri paran oni roye da reyo omote re ijipt vwo ke vwo rovwo

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke yena, Abimẹlẹk vi Fikol rẹ onotu rẹ ofovwi rọye da ta kẹ Ebraham, Ọghẹnẹ vẹ owẹ herọ vwẹ emu kemu ri wo ruẹ ejobi,
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke yena abimelek vi fikol re onotu re ofovwi roye da ta ke ebraham oghene ve owe hero vwe emu kemu ri wo rue ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ etinẹ na gba vwẹ Ọghẹnẹ duvwu iyori nẹ wo shenyẹ vwẹ ekueku eyẹ ọmọ mẹ eyẹ uvwiẹ mẹ, ẹkẹvuọvo obo re Me vwẹ obo tete uwe na, eriyin wo ji ru kẹ vwẹ kugbe otọ nana ru wọ diare jovwo na.
verses.text_romanized: vwe etine na gba vwe oghene duvwu iyori ne wo shenye vwe ekueku eye omo me eye uvwie me ekevuovo obo re me vwe obo tete uwe na eriyin wo ji ru ke vwe kugbe oto nana ru wo diare jovwo na

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da ta, Mi duvwo.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da ta mi duvwo

verses.text_urhobo: Ọke rẹ Ebraham vwo gu kẹ Abimẹlẹk kpahe orhare rẹ ame rẹ idibo rẹ Abimẹlẹk gborhori.
verses.text_romanized: oke re ebraham vwo gu ke abimelek kpahe orhare re ame re idibo re abimelek gborhori

verses.text_urhobo: Abimẹlẹk da ta, Me riẹn ohwo ro ru emu nana-a; wọ ta kẹ vwẹ jovwo-o, mi ji nyo ota nana rhi te nonẹ na-a.
verses.text_romanized: abimelek da ta me rien ohwo ro ru emu nana a wo ta ke vwe jovwo o mi ji nyo ota nana rhi te none na a

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebraham da reyọ ogodẹ kugbe erhuẹn ọ da vwẹ ayen kẹ Abimẹlẹk, ayen ihwo ivẹ na da re ọphọ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham da reyo ogode kugbe erhuen o da vwe ayen ke abimelek ayen ihwo ive na da re opho

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da reyọ upene rẹ igodẹ rẹ eya ighwrẹ vwẹ ohri rẹ uchuru rọye na phihọ orhọ.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da reyo upene re igode re eya ighwre vwe ohri re uchuru roye na phiho orho

verses.text_urhobo: Abimẹlẹk da ta kẹ Ebraham, Kidie otọ rẹ upene rẹ igodẹ rẹ eya ighwrẹ ru wọ vwọ orhọ na?
verses.text_romanized: abimelek da ta ke ebraham kidie oto re upene re igode re eya ighwre ru wo vwo orho na

verses.text_urhobo: O da ta, Igodẹ rẹ eya nana ighwrẹ na gba reyọ ayen mie vwe, rere e dia iseri nẹ mẹvwẹ ri ghine tọn orhare na.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta igode re eya nana ighwre na gba reyo ayen mie vwe rere e dia iseri ne mevwe ri ghine ton orhare na

verses.text_urhobo: Fiki rẹ ọtiọye na e de se asan na Bẹẹrsheba, fikiridie Etiyin ayen ihwo ivẹ na da re ọphọ.
verses.text_romanized: fiki re otioye na e de se asan na beersheba fikiridie etiyin ayen ihwo ive na da re opho

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin ayen da re ọphọ vwi Bẹẹrsheba Abimẹlẹk vẹ Fikol rẹ onotu rẹ ofovwi rọye de vrẹn ayen da rhoma rhivwi kpo otọ ri Filistia.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ayen da re opho vwi beersheba abimelek ve fikol re onotu re ofovwi roye de vren ayen da rhoma rhivwi kpo oto ri filistia

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da kọn oghriki phihọ Bẹẹrsheba, o de se odẹ rẹ Ọrovwohwo vwẹ Etiyin, Ọghẹnẹ ri bẹvwẹdẹ na.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da kon oghriki phiho beersheba o de se ode re orovwohwo vwe etiyin oghene ri bevwede na

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da dia otọ ri Filistia na krekri.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da dia oto ri filistia na krekri

headings.text_urhobo: A djẹ Hagar kugbe Ishmael kufia
headings.text_romanized: a dje hagar kugbe ishmael kufia

headings.text_urhobo: Ọphọ rẹ Ebraham vẹ Abimẹlẹk rere
headings.text_romanized: opho re ebraham ve abimelek rere
